findings.claim: Half done. /extract-claims now has a real end-to-end run through MCP (run 3 passes), but /write-checks and its kmaudit-check-writer agent were never run, and the plan's checked-by says the skills' evals are rerun.
results.md credited tests/test_skills.py with the agents' tools check.

verdict.text: Narrow round.
f2 is fixed in both results.md files.
f1 is half fixed.
The extract-claims run shows the main session sending the work to kmaudit-claims-extractor, and the agent storing claims through `claims_submit` with no shell.
That was the real risk.
write-checks has not had the same run.
The new SKILL.md sentence is accurate and does no harm.
Nothing blocks.
Gates: I reran `loopctl gate stamp` in the worktree.
Lint, format, tests and integration pass, eval rows r1 to r5 pass, "stamp green: 74d5c007b1ad27a45155c30ef5cd8d67f8452f7703abbc915a910f88aaafbc37".
Transcripts: I parsed transcript.jsonl, transcript2.jsonl and transcript3.jsonl myself.
In all three the kmaudit project server is connected and kmaudit-claims-extractor is loaded.
Run 3: the main session calls ToolSearch, then `claims_todo` on `<repo>/.okf`, then dispatches the agent once.
The agent calls `claims_todo` per concept and `claims_submit` twice, with `by: kmaudit-claims-extractor` and the namespace folder.
Nobody calls Bash.
The final reply shows counts only: 0 pending, 3 point claims and 1 subjective.
Run 2 has the one main-session Bash `ls -d .okf docs` that results.md describes.
These match what results.md claims.

The SKILL.md sentence (no folder named: call the todo tool on the root's `.okf` straight away, and its refusal says when the folder is missing): I called `claims_todo` and `checks_todo` from mcp_server.py on a repo with no `.okf`.
Both raise ToolError "... .okf does not exist; give a folder of markdown docs or a page in one".
So the sentence is true.
It also fits step 1's "a tool error is a refusal: quote it and stop".
In write-checks it is the same sentence with `checks_todo`, which is right.
f2: both results.md files now credit `packages/kmaudit/tests/test_apm_package.py` with the agents' tools check and test_skills.py with the tool-name and no-shell checks.
f1 (open, missing, not blocking): extract-claims is covered end to end.
results.md says "write-checks and the no-agent eval were not run", and write-checks' results.md still says its evals were not rerun.
The check-writer uses the same mechanism (a subagent calling project MCP tools) that run 3 proved, so a plain rerun of run.sh's shape for /write-checks after the claims run is enough.
I do not need to see it again.
Results go in write-checks' results.md.
f2 (resolved): fixed in both results.md files, as above.
Run 2's `claims_submit` call had no `by` field.
Run 3's calls do.
The agent file asks for it, so this is model variance, not a defect.
The `.summary` file for run 1 reads "1 1 1", but the transcript shows no Bash call.
That fits results.md's note that run 1's script output was wrong.
It does not affect run 3.
